# Admire Madyira

> Software Engineer at Microsoft AI, working on release, update, and deployment infrastructure for Copilot and Microsoft Edge. Previously worked on C++ browser performance/latency optimization for Edge, and on applied ML research into Copilot safety and robustness to adversarial attacks (e.g. prompt injection).

Based in Redmond, WA. BA Computer Science, Amherst College. MS Computer Science (Machine Learning), Columbia University, in progress.

## Experience

- Software Engineer, Microsoft AI (Aug 2025–Present) — release/deployment infrastructure for Copilot and Edge.
- Software Engineer Intern, Generative AI, Microsoft (May–Aug 2024) — Copilot reliability, security, and safety research.
- Software Engineer Intern, Search Optimization, Microsoft (May–Aug 2023) — Edge browser search optimization and latency reduction in C++.
- Machine Learning Engineer Intern, Columbia University (Jun–Aug 2022) — reinforcement learning research for self-driving cars.
- Full Stack Engineer Apprentice, Google Africa Developer Scholarship (Aug 2021–May 2022).

## Projects

- QuantIQ (https://github.com/Mireinstein/QuantIQ) — C++20 algorithmic trading bot: target-position engine reconciling against live broker state, multithreaded market-data pipeline, historical replay and live Alpaca paper trading on one code path. Dashboard: https://admiremadyira.com/QuantIQ/dashboard.html
- Grey Parrot (https://github.com/Mireinstein/Grey-Parrot) — Chrome extension for live translated subtitles on any video.
- Agnostic LLM Watermarking (https://github.com/Mireinstein/Agnostic-LLM-Watermarking) — compares prompt-level and token-level LLM watermarking across ~2,000 generated responses; RoBERTa detectors recover 86% of prompt-based watermarks against 66% of token-level ones.
